items.title: Musk Says AT&T and Verizon May “Lose Some Revenue” as Starlink’s Phone Service Gets 40x the Bandwidth
items.summary: Key TakeawaysElon Musk said SpaceX’s next direct-to-cell satellites, launching in 2027, will have 40x the bandwidth, and AT&T and Verizon may lose some revenue. The hit looks small for now, since satellite signals struggle to reach phones indoors, but SpaceX’s planned rooftop micro cell towers aim at that gap.

items.title: Shots Fired: Meta Will Reportedly Sell a $300 Muse Charm With Free Verizon 5G as Apple Builds Its Agent
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMeta reportedly plans to sell a $300 Muse Charm with up to 12 months of free Verizon 5G, and is targeting 10 million wearable sales in the second half of 2026. A connected device would let Meta reach users without Apple’s phones in between, just as Apple reportedly builds its own AI agent.
